standard_prerequisites.name: Ogoma's annihilator lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the multiplier s in S realizing the annihilator equality at each induction step.

standard_prerequisites.name: Regular sequences in regular local rings
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, lemma regular-ring-CM and lemma regular-sequence-powers (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Give that the parameters form a regular sequence and that powers preserve regularity.

core_obligations: Pick pi_1, ..., pi_d generating q Lambda_q (possible as Lambda_q is regular of dimension d).
Since pi_i^n lies in I Lambda_q, multiply each pi_i by an element s_i of S to get pi_i^n in I; properties (1) and (2) survive further multiplication by elements of S.

Induct on t: assuming the annihilator equality of (3) for i at most t, regularity gives the equality after localization, and Ogoma's lemma produces s in S with the equality for the multiplied pi_{t+1} over Lambda.
proof_roadmap: Parameter selection; multiplication into I; Ogoma induction; verification.
difficulty_reason: A three-step induction through the regular-sequence lemmas and the carded Ogoma lemma.
